title: Creation of a Numerical Scoring System to Objectively Measure and Compare the Level of Rhetoric in Arabic Texts: A Feasibility Study, and A Working Prototype
reasoning: The dissertation uses the Quran as a primary source for its linguistic analysis, specifically using Surah Ibrahim as a sample for 'very high' rhetorical density. It also draws on theological and hermeneutic concepts within Arabic rhetoric (balāgha) which is fundamentally linked to the study of Quranic inimitability.
